(2) The scene shifts to a mirror selfie where the woman stands sideways, showing her physique and workout outfit while holding a silver smartphone. Large white text overlays the center of the frame. The gym lighting is bright and even. (4) The woman performs chest flyes using a cable machine while lying on an incline bench. The camera captures a close-up of her concentrated facial expression and the rhythmic movement of her arms pulling the cables. (5) From a top-down perspective, she lies on a flat bench performing dumbbell chest presses, rotating the weights at the top of the movement. The surrounding gym equipment is visible in the background. (6) She continues on the bench, performing dumbbell pullovers by extending a single dumbbell behind her head and pulling it back over her chest. Her movements are controlled and rhythmic. (7) Standing at a cable station, she performs triceps pushdowns using a rope attachment, pulling downward with her elbows tucked. The background shows other gym-goers and workout equipment. (8) She turns around to perform overhead triceps extensions with the cable, lunging forward slightly for stability. The camera shows her side profile as she extends the rope over her head. (9) The final scene returns to a mirror selfie where she smiles at her reflection and holds her phone, indicating the workout is complete.
